upstream_release_tag: v0.4.0 (811bdb1); source_commit also includes the unreleased keyless search and multi-key scheduling batches
integration_status: core and node-sdk depend on vendor/nb-search-0.4.0-4218580a.tgz
hosted_worker_api: Expose existing launcher injection and side-effect-free runWorker with readiness callback; no file admission or operation fingerprint changes.
tavily_api: Align every Tavily lane to the official API reference: /search and /extract use the Authorization Bearer header and documented body fields (time_range instead of the undocumented days, include_published_date, extract format/extract_depth), /crawl is added as a typed lane returning fetch-shaped page documents, and /research is added as the official create-then-poll async task lane. tavily.synthesis is retained as the documented /search include_answer answer. Provider adapter_version moved from 1 to 2 with the operation fingerprint change. The key scheduler test expects Bearer authorization rather than the old request-body key.
scope: Rebase the three Kiki-specific patches onto nb-search 0.4.0 plus commits 66aa4ac and f7cbfde0 (keyless defaults and multi-key scheduling). File-scope identity and hosted-worker exports remain Kiki-only; Tavily official API parity remains a separate patch. One key remains compatible with the existing secrets.json format; ordered comma-separated keys enable scheduling without copying key material into config.toml.
apply: git apply vendor/nb-search-patches/canonical-target/source.patch, then hosted-worker.patch, then tavily-official.patch onto a clean f7cbfde0a7cf31951ed775598ad0cb6cc3fade6b checkout
replay_check: git apply --check and apply each patch in order onto a clean f7cbfde0a7cf31951ed775598ad0cb6cc3fade6b checkout; git write-tree after replay equals 0a1da8f62f8f49a3cf11813c3378fdaaabd1ef0c, the patched build checkout tree
test: pnpm typecheck && pnpm exec vitest run
